- **Lines-free orders:** The `(no items)` case was already shown earlier, with `order_count` 1 and zero revenue. The test also ran against the live data in `aidb`. That data is back to its original state, apart from the extra `etl_run_log` rows those runs added.

### FILE: etl.sql
```
-- ETL: populate dashboard tables from source; reconcile. Idempotent (full refresh in one txn).
BEGIN;
CREATE TEMP TABLE _run ON COMMIT DROP AS SELECT clock_timestamp() AS started_at;

TRUNCATE dash_revenue_by_category, dash_revenue_by_country;

-- One controlling line per COMPLETED order (lowest order_item_id); orders with no
-- joinable lines fall into the '(no items)' sentinel.
INSERT INTO dash_revenue_by_category (month, category, revenue, order_count, units_sold)
SELECT to_char(o.order_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM'),
       COALESCE(c.category, '(no items)'),
       COALESCE(SUM(c.quantity * c.unit_price), 0),
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),
       COALESCE(SUM(c.quantity), 0)
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT p.category, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id
    ORDER BY oi.order_item_id
    LIMIT 1
) c ON true
WHERE o.status = 'COMPLETED'
GROUP BY 1, 2;

-- Country rollup: revenue = all lines of completed orders.
INSERT INTO dash_revenue_by_country (month, country, revenue, customer_count)
SELECT to_char(o.order_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM'),
       cu.country,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.rev), 0),
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id)
FROM orders o
JOIN customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS rev
           FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'COMPLETED'
GROUP BY 1, 2;

-- Reconciliation
INSERT INTO etl_run_log (started_at, finished_at, source_order_count, loaded_order_count, mismatch)
SELECT (SELECT started_at FROM _run), clock_timestamp(), s.n, l.n, s.n - l.n
FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM orders WHERE status = 'COMPLETED') s,
     (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(order_count), 0) n FROM dash_revenue_by_category) l;

-- Hard gate: fail the run if not reconciled (logged row is rolled back with it).
DO $$ BEGIN
  IF (SELECT mismatch FROM etl_run_log ORDER BY run_id DESC LIMIT 1) <> 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'reconciliation mismatch <> 0';
  END IF;
END $$;
COMMIT;
```
reason: ETL idempotent, dashboard loaded, reconciliation mismatch = 0
